saints.name: St. Peter Chrysologus
saints.title: Bishop and Doctor of the Church
saints.shortBlurb: The “golden-worded” archbishop of Ravenna whose brief, luminous sermons still instruct the Church…
biography: Peter, archbishop of Ravenna in the first half of the fifth century, earned the surname Chrysologus, “golden-worded,” for the clarity and warmth of his preaching. His many short sermons, expounding the Creed, the Lord's Prayer, and the mysteries of the faith with simplicity and fervor, have been treasured ever since.
He supported orthodoxy in the doctrinal disputes of his day and is remembered for a letter counseling Eutyches to submit to the See of Rome. He was declared a Doctor of the Church in 1729.
saints.knownFor: His concise, luminous sermons and title as Doctor of the Church.

canonization.canonized: Venerated from antiquity; Doctor of the Church (1729)
